royal bank of canada reaffirms buy rating for apple

text:
Posted by Dee Baugher on Jan 21st, 2019 // No Comments
Royal Bank of Canada reiterated their buy rating on shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) in a research note published on Friday morning. The firm currently has a $185.00 target price on the iPhone maker’s stock.
Several other brokerages have also commented on AAPL. DA Davidson dropped their price target on shares of Apple to $260.00 and set a buy rating on the stock in a research note on Thursday, January 3rd. Robert W. Baird dropped their price target on shares of Apple from $230.00 to $185.00 and set an outperform rating on the stock in a research note on Thursday, January 3rd. Citigroup dropped their price target on shares of Apple from $265.00 to $240.00 and set a buy rating on the stock in a research note on Friday, November 2nd. ValuEngine lowered shares of Apple from a hold rating to a sell rating in a research note on Friday, January 4th. Finally, Bank of America restated a buy rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, October 9th. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have issued a hold rating and twenty-two have issued a buy rating to the stock. The stock currently has a consensus rating of Hold and a consensus target price of $195.74. Get Apple alerts:
Apple stock opened at $156.82 on Friday. The company has a market capitalization of $770.79 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 13.17, a P/E/G ratio of 1.49 and a beta of 1.23. The company has a current ratio of 1.12, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. Apple has a twelve month low of $142.00 and a twelve month high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 EPS for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. The company had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the business posted $2.07 EPS. Apple’s quarterly revenue was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. Equities research analysts forecast that Apple will post 12.1 earnings per share for the current year.
In other Apple news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the stock in a transaction on Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available through the SEC website . 0.05% of the stock is owned by corporate insiders.
Institutional investors have recently modified their holdings of the business. Landsberg Bennett & Dubbaneh LLC bought a new position in shares of Apple during the 4th quarter worth about $1,435,000. Truewealth LLC lifted its holdings in shares of Apple by 7.3% during the 4th quarter. Truewealth LLC now owns 25,973 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,097,000 after acquiring an additional 1,757 shares during the period. Strategic Family Wealth Counselors L.L.C. bought a new position in shares of Apple during the 4th quarter worth about $914,000. Diversified Trust Co lifted its holdings in shares of Apple by 367.7% during the 4th quarter. Diversified Trust Co now owns 70,285 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $11,087,000 after acquiring an additional 55,257 shares during the period. Finally, Paragon Capital Management LLC lifted its holdings in shares of Apple by 16.4% during the 4th quarter. Paragon Capital Management LLC now owns 4,714 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $743,000 after acquiring an additional 664 shares during the period. 57.04% of the stock is owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
